cards.title: Why Parenthood Feels Impossible for Millennial Mothers
cards.body: Millennial mothers today are more educated and employed than previous generations, yet report feeling overwhelmed. An exploration of why modern parenting expectations create such pressure and how to find relief.

cards.title: Helicopter Pilots Wave to Delighted Three-Year-Old
cards.body: A heartwarming moment when helicopter pilots looped back to wave at a child who adores helicopters. The small act of kindness brought pure joy to a toddler.

cards.title: Working Parents Face Logistical Nightmare with School Holidays
cards.body: The school day ending at 3pm creates scheduling chaos for working parents juggling childcare. Emily Mulligan explores how school holiday planning becomes endless life admin.

cards.title: Play School Returns with Quality TV for Toddlers
cards.body: The return of Play School offers a calm alternative to frantic children's programming designed to grab attention like phones do. Parent Natalie Morris celebrates finding guilt-free screen time for her two-year-old.

cards.title: Secret Codeword Helps Kids Feel Safe at Sleepovers
cards.body: Polly Hudson suggests establishing a discreet codeword so children can signal distress at sleepovers without embarrassment. This simple strategy gives kids control and reassurance during their first nights away.

cards.title: How to Help Anxious Child Sleep Without Hours of Struggle
cards.body: Anxiety and fear of the dark don't require parents to spend hours getting children to sleep or losing sleep themselves. Strategies exist to help anxious children develop better sleep habits independently.

cards.title: Teen Brain Changes: The Invisible Puberty Parents Miss
cards.body: Significant brain development happens during adolescence that affects focus and attention. With parental support and teen-chosen strategies, teenagers can meaningfully improve their ability to concentrate.

cards.title: What Children's Lies Reveal About Their Development
cards.body: While parents worry about children lying, research shows these falsehoods reveal important clues about cognitive development. Kids' lies indicate how they think, learn, and understand others.

cards.title: Couples Delay Divorce Due to Cost of Living Crisis
cards.body: Financial pressures are keeping unhappy couples in failed marriages longer than before. Divorce lawyers report the average length of marriages ending in divorce has increased in England and Wales.

cards.title: Mental Load Imbalance in Households Leads to Burnout
cards.body: When one partner carries too much mental load for home and family, burnout or breakup often follow. Women particularly struggle from uneven distribution of domestic duties and planning responsibilities.
